text:
Oliver Grant: Hi finance  I paid for a client dinner on my personal card, merchant shows `BRAUHAUS BERLIN 148.20 EUR` on 2025-10-14. Restaurant gave a receipt but it's made out to me and missing a VAT ID. I attached photo: [invoice_brauhaus_101425.jpg]. Card converted to USD on my bank to 160.12 USD. I also left a 5 EUR cash tip. How should I submit for reimbursement and can the company reclaim VAT?

expenses-bot: Policy reminder: personal-card expenses require manager approval and a merchant invoice addressed to the company for VAT reclaim in EU. If vendor cannot issue corrected invoice with VAT ID & company name, VAT may be non-recoverable and treated as a business expense. Upload meeting proof and attendee list.

Helena Fischer: Approving the reimbursement  this was a client dinner with ClientCo (invoice attached). @Oliver pls ask the restaurant if they can reissue the invoice to "Redwood GmbH" with their VAT ID and line-level VAT. If they can't, we will reimburse gross but we won't reclaim VAT.

Finance Ops: Hi all  quick process note: 1) For VAT reclaim we need vendor VAT number + invoice addressed to Redwood GmbH (no personal names). 2) If vendor reissues within 30 days, AP will process VAT reclaim and code journals to VAT-RECOV-EU. 3) If vendor can't reissue, finance will reimburse the gross amount and tag as VAT_NONRECOV (GL: TRV-EU-CLIENT). Please attach the meeting invite and attendee names for entertainment documentation.

Oliver Grant: Uploaded meeting invite and attendee list (ClientCo kickoff, 2025-10-14). I messaged the restaurant and they said they can issue a corrected invoice but need our company VAT ID and billing address. What's the billing address?

Helena Fischer: Billing details for Redwood GmbH: Redwood GmbH, Sonnenallee 12, 10179 Berlin, DE. VAT ID: DE123456789. Please request the vendor include booking date, line items (food/drink), VAT rate and VAT amount.

Max Chen: Small follow-up  is the 5 EUR cash tip reimbursable? It was cash, not on card. Policy allows tips up to 20% with manager approval. Helena approved the dinner—does that include tip?

Helena Fischer: Approving cash tip of 5 EUR. :white_check_mark:

Finance Ops: For AP processing: Oliver, submit via Ramp as a "Personal Card - Travel" expense, attach corrected vendor invoice (or current invoice + vendor email confirming reissue), attendee list, and bank details for reimbursement. If vendor reissues invoice to Redwood GmbH, VAT reclaim will be attempted; otherwise VAT will be non-recoverable and expense coded accordingly. Reimbursements from personal cards are processed weekly; reference EXP-33421 once queued.

Oliver Grant: Thanks  I've forwarded the VAT ID to the restaurant and asked them to reissue. I'll upload the corrected invoice when it arrives. Bank details & Ramp submission next.

expenses-bot: Expense pending document upload. Once invoice is updated this thread will be closed and AP will pick up EXP-33421.
